note: Structural impact classification. 'up' = instances that depend on the changed one (toward A1); 'down' = instances it depends on (toward A4). Relations not listed are no_impact. An architect confirms every classification before design changes.

modify.reason: internal change; direct neighbours re-check their assumptions, nothing further

replace.reason: instance replaced; direct dependents must re-point their mappings, indirect ones review

retire.reason: instance removed; direct dependents lose a dependency, indirect ones review

rehost.reason: hosting changes only; deployment records must be superseded, functional layers unaffected
